mechanics_source_witnesses.title: Damage Reflection
mechanics_source_witnesses.quote: For example, if the combined damage reflection of all worn equipment is 80, it will still only reflect a maximum of 50 damage on creatures with 5000 health points.
mechanics_source_witnesses.full_raw_content: {{Version Widget|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | implemented = 11.40.5409 | seealso = }}'''Damage Reflection''' is a passive ability that some creatures have and that players can have through some equipment. It's similar to the [[Parry|Parry Charm]]. __TOC__ == Damage Reflection by Players == Characters can receive the ability to reflect damage through some equipment listed below. Damage reflection in this case has some special rules: * The reflected damage cannot be greater than 1% of the maximum [[HP|hit points]] of the attacker. ** For example, if the combined damage reflection of all worn equipment is 80, it will still only reflect a maximum of 50 damage on creatures with 5000 health points. ** This 1% limit can be exceeded through the use of [[Prey System|Damage Boost Prey]] on a selected creature, so the maximum amount of damage reflection can be higher. * Damage reflection is only triggered by [[melee]] damage. * It does not affect [[Bosses]]. * It is shown as dark purple text. So 32 damage would show up as 32. === List of Items that have Damage Reflection === {{DPL Table| | headers= !Name!!!!Vocation!!Min. Level!!Attributes | table_class = wikitable sortable | table_style = text-align:center; | tablerow = [[%TITLE%]]¦¦[[File:%TITLE%.gif]]¦¦%%,%%,%% | sortcol = 1 | no_results = There are no results. | categories = Items with Damage Reflection | uses_template = Template:Infobox Object | includes= {Infobox Object}:vocrequired:levelrequired:attrib }} == Damage Reflection by Creatures == Creatures with this ability will reflect a certain percentage of the damage they receive to the aggressor. This percentage can be much greater than 100%, meaning a lot more damage than was initially dealt. The Creature's resistances is not affected by this, some creatures reflect the damage of elements they are immune against, while others reflect damage of elements they are neutral to. When you deal damage to a creature with damage reflection (for example neutral with 10% reflection), the following messages are displayed on the [[Server Log Channel]]: :{{Server Message|You lose 115 hitpoints due to an attack by ''Creature''. (damage reflection)}} :{{Server Message|''Creature'' loses 1150 hitpoints due to your attack.}} __TOC__ === List of Creatures that use Damage Reflection === {| class = "wikitable sortable" style="text-align:center;" ! mechanics_source_witnesses.title: Cleave
mechanics_source_witnesses.quote: When the main target would receive 10 [[Physical Damage]] and 50 [[Fire Damage]] (before reduction), this would lead to the secondary targets receiving 10% of that: 1 physical damage and 5 fire damage.
mechanics_source_witnesses.full_raw_content:
{{Version Widget|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| implemented  = 12.70.10953
}}
'''Cleave''', introduced with [[Summer Update 2021]], is a way to deal more damage than usual. Cleave is a modifier applied to a few [[Knight]] weapons, dealing damage to two targets immediately at the side of a character's main target.

For Cleave, [[Charms]] and [[Life Leech]]/[[Mana Leech]] will not be triggered on secondary targets. Secondary targets with [[Damage Reflection]] also reflect the Cleave damage back to the player.

An example for damage calculation would be an [[Axes|axe]] with "Atk:10 physical + 50 fire" and "10% Cleave". When the main target would receive 10 [[Physical Damage]] and 50 [[Fire Damage]] (before reduction), this would lead to the secondary targets receiving 10% of that: 1 physical damage and 5 fire damage. It is then that the creature's defense might further reduce the actual damage they suffer.

mechanics_source_witnesses.title: Perfect Shot
mechanics_source_witnesses.quote: A player wielding this bow and attacking a target at range 4 or 6, dealing 240 damage, would deal 265 damage to a target at range 5.
mechanics_source_witnesses.full_raw_content:
{{Version Widget|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| implemented  = 12.70.10953
}}
'''Perfect Shot''', introduced with [[Summer Update 2021]], is a way to deal more damage than usual. Perfect Shots are applied to only a single target, and only when the target is exactly at the range defined by the equipment that grants this modifier.

The modifier is primarily found on [[Quivers]] for [[Paladin]]s, but can also be found in some [[Wands]]. 

An example for an item with this type of modifier would be a bow with "+25 bonus at range 5" and "Range:6". A player wielding this bow and attacking a target at range 4 or 6, dealing 240 damage, would deal 265 damage to a target at range 5. If AoE [[Missiles|arrows]] are used, only the primary target will be dealt the additional damage.

It has been confirmed by users in the community that Perfect Shot bypasses raid boss [[Mitigation]], which makes it valuable for rare raids such as [[Ghazbaran]], although it can be hard to apply properly due to the amount of players and effects on the screen.<ref>[https://discord.com/channels/404607250607636481/404607576806785035/1296892858342576210 TibiaWiki's Official Discord]</ref>
